body.title: Pass the four records through DocsContent on the client
body.summary: Mirror the same four optional members on DocsContent in vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-client.ts (currently three members at :24-28) and carry them through the content() mapping unchanged. Strictly pass-through: no reshaping, no validation, no defaulting. s1 itself consumes none of them — this task exists so s2, s3 and s4 never have to reopen the client file.
acceptanceChecks: a view carrying all four records round-trips through content() with every record byte-identical on the far side
a view carrying none of them yields a DocsContent with all four absent
the three pre-existing members keep their current meaning and the existing docs-review-client tests pass unchanged
the client still throws on the daemon's structured { error } arm exactly as before, so an unavailable read is still distinguishable from an empty one
no new rpc method name appears in the client

tests.name: content() round-trips a view carrying all four structured records with each one unmodified — the verified pass-through s2/s3/s4 inherit
content() on a view carrying none of the four yields all four absent
content() still throws on the daemon's { error } arm, keeping unavailable distinguishable from empty
source-scan: no new rpc method name appears in docs-review-client
